methodology.arrivals: paced open loop; latency measured from scheduled arrival, including client queue and dispatch delay
methodology.durability: Kestrel synchronized segments/catalog; SQLite WAL FULL; PostgreSQL synchronous_commit on; InnoDB flush-at-commit 1; DuckDB durable autocommit
methodology.indexes: Kestrel sparse prefixes; SQLite/MySQL/MariaDB covering ts,value; PostgreSQL ts INCLUDE(value); DuckDB zonemaps
methodology.interfaces: Kestrel Rust loopback JSON test bridge with public LiveArchive snapshots/group commits; references native Python bindings/protocols
methodology.parallelism: one execution thread per query, up to 64 simultaneous clients; no CPU affinity
methodology.workload: read hotspot 80% in 1% timestamp domain; mixed 5% append, write 25% append; append timestamps 5% late; scan profile includes full grouping and unordered filters
limits: single shared machine and loopback only
short rate sweeps and one-minute soak
no replication or distributed failure testing
